gloss: to strip, to peel off, to tear off

definitions.gloss: to strip off, to peel off, to tear off
definitions.explanation: To forcefully remove something that covers or clings to a surface — such as skin, bark, clothing, paint, or a mask. Implies a rougher, more forceful action than simply peeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}いで⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I peel off the skin and eat it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}いで⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I put up new wallpaper after stripping off the old one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}いで⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The thief stripped the victim of their clothes and fled.

notes:
Conjugates as a godan verb: {剥|は}がない, {剥|は}いで, {剥|は}いだ. The action is more forceful and rough compared to ⟦{剥|む}く→剥く：02305_muku⟧ (to peel gently, as with fruit).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {剥|は}ぐ — to strip/tear off (forceful removal of a covering)
- ⟦{剥|む}く→剥く：02305_muku⟧ — to peel (gentler; fruit, vegetables)
- ⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧ — to peel off, to remove (stickers, labels, tape)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}ぐ (to strip off skin/bark)
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}ぐ (to strip someone of clothes)
- ⟦{仮面|かめん}→仮面：11439_kamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剥|は}ぐ (to tear off a mask — also figurative)
